patch_description:
The current approach ties pre- and post-entanglement RZ rotations to a single shared parameter ("rz_shared"), achieving excellent parameter efficiency (14 params, score 0.72) but with slower convergence (90 steps). By splitting the RZ layer into two separate but still fully-shared parameters—"rz_pre" before entanglement and "rz_post" after—we increase from 2 trainable parameters (ry_shared, rz_shared) to 3 (ry_shared, rz_pre, rz_post). This modest increase should:

1. Improve the optimization landscape by allowing more flexible rotation gates
2. Reduce convergence time from 90 steps closer to the ~60 steps observed with prior successful configurations
3. Maintain excellent parameter efficiency (3 parameters vs. 56 in the first program and only 7 more than the minimum)
4. Preserve the perfect accuracy and zero generalization gap

This aligns with the trend seen in prior programs where decoupling overly-constrained parameters improved convergence while maintaining accuracy.
